productConcept.name: SONOR
productConcept.description: Professional acoustic measurement and room correction software for recording studios, audiophiles, and acoustic engineers.
productConcept.rationale: The spectral gradient palette (pink #ea3a8c → purple #bf5af2 → indigo #5e5ce6 → cyan #32ade6) maps directly to frequency spectrum visualization — a defining visual metaphor for audio analysis tools. The Apple-precision white interface (#fbfbfd, tight grid, restrained typography) matches the aesthetic language of professional audio software. The deep navy accent system (#0a3480, #1c1c6e) provides the dark, focused UI mode that audio engineers prefer for studio monitoring contexts. The stagger cascade motion (14 elements, 0.1s increments) mirrors the sequential step-by-step logic of acoustic measurement workflows.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion system has non-trivial durations (0.32s–0.9s), named easing curves (cubic-bezier), and scroll references in concept_by_video.md
